blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Supreme Court (SC) Associate Justice Rodil Vaquilar Zalameda received an honorary Doctor of Laws degree from the University of the East (UE) in Manila on Tuesday. According to the UE, Zalameda—who was also recognized twice before as one of the university’s outstanding alumni—is the 36th person the university has awarded the honorary degree to since 1957. “UE confers the distinction to exceptional individuals whose noteworthy accomplishments in their respective professions, public service and humanitarian endeavors have significantly contributed to the advancement of society, rule of law, and national development, embodying the core values and institutional mission of the […]... Keep on reading: SC Associate Justice Zalameda receives UE’s honorary degree
